sources.title: LexM — Mayer-Mahr, Moritz
sources.researchNote: The live LexM entry documents Mayer-Mahr’s teaching at the Klindworth-Scharwenka Conservatory in Berlin from 1892 to 1937, his service from 1907 on the jury of the Ibach competition at the Stern Conservatory, and his work until 1933 on the senate of the Academy of Arts as an expert in music pedagogy. It names Róża Etkin among his pupils. The entry does not mention Kaper; it supplies biographical and institutional context for Mayer-Mahr, whom other sources identify as Kaper’s private teacher in Berlin between 1926 and 1930. An earlier PDF copy hosted by the Xaver-Scharwenka-Stiftung is retained as an alternate access copy.
